body:
The downloadable editor-demo-linux-x86_64.tar.gz/editor-demo-windows-x86_64.zip never actually contained any PARENA source -- only the binary, bundled SDL2 libs, a font, and a build-identifying snapshot file. Fixed: the release job now copies src/stdlib/examples/runtime/docs + Makefile/STDLIB.md/NORTHSTAR.md/README.md into both platform archive dirs before archiving, plus the real parena compiler binary into the Linux one. Live-verified by locally reproducing the exact packaging step: extracted the resulting tar.gz and ran the bundled ./parena build examples/avr/blink.prn against the bundled blink.prn from a clean directory -- works. make test: 347/347.

⚓ ☃
title: Real fix: bundle actual PARENA source + compiler binary into editor-demo release archives
